verdict.rationale: n8n is a workflow platform, not itself an agent, so the MCP server axis applies. Its docs list a first-party MCP Server Trigger node, and a probe confirms the official MCP server is documented at that page. This suggests agents can connect to n8n workflows over MCP, but the pack shows only the page title, so setup, transport, auth and exposed tools are unevidenced, and tools apparently must be built as workflows rather than shipped as a turnkey server. Missing for 10: documented connection steps and auth for external agents, description of which tools or capabilities are exposed, hands-on or independent corroboration of agents connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
